lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the branchial region, with the highest density of distinct centroids clustered in the mid-lateral section of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, forming a regular grid pattern with the spots acting as anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally along the upper two-thirds of the flank, characterized by a lighter dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge creating a sharp vertical intensity gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of small, high-luminance circular blobs.
